title: Blueprint Builder Arcade
intro: Classes are blueprints for building objects! Design them, create them, and pass down family traits. First-try wins earn ⭐⭐⭐!

rounds.prompt: Which keyword creates a blueprint (a class)?
rounds.explain: We use the class keyword to design a new type of object.
We built a Dog named Rex, and d.name reads back the name we stored.

rounds.prompt: This method is missing something important. Pick the fix.
rounds.explain: Methods inside a class need self as their first input so they know which object they belong to.

options: Reuse the traits and methods of another class
rounds.explain: Inheritance passes down 'family traits', a child class gets the parent's abilities for free.
We made a Hero object and called its shout() method, which prints the message.

rounds.prompt: Build a simple class, create an object from it, and call its method.
rounds.explain: Define the class and its method first, then create an object and call the method on it.
